Name: Obadiah, Overseer
Summary: Obadiah, a Levite of the sons of Merari, was an overseer of the workmen repairing the house of the LORD under Josiah.
KeyStory: The overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the sons of Merari, to set the work forward.
LifeLesson: Merarite overseers shared the repair with Kohathites.
